name: G15
author: andeen171
description: Dell G15 CPU/GPU temps and fan rpm in the Omarchy bar, with a panel for power modes and the RGB keyboard backlight.

barWidget.description: Temps and fans in the bar; click for power modes, fan boost and the keyboard backlight. Needs the `g15` CLI (github.com/andeen171/g15-cli).

schema.label: Show temperatures in the bar
schema.description: Off shows the keyboard glyph instead; the panel still has everything.

schema.label: Privileged g15 command
schema.description: Prefixed to `power <mode>` and `fan boost <n>`, which need root — see the plugin README for the sudoers lines.

schema.label: TUI command
schema.description: Run by right-clicking the widget or the panel's Open TUI button.
